Techtronics faces significant business risks in launching its new smartphone. Market risks include intense competition in a saturated market, uncertain consumer adoption of the unique feature, and the potential for rapid obsolescence due to the fast-paced innovation cycle in the mobile industry. Operational risks may involve challenges in manufacturing, supply chain disruptions, and the need for continuous R&D investment to stay competitive.
